basic_info.description: Experience elevated living in this sleek, south-facing residence, thoughtfully redesigned with clean lines, high-end features, and an enviable location at the heart of the City. Enjoy an abundance of natural light and breathtaking, rare Bay-To-Ocean views, something truly unique in Diamond Heights Village. This top-floor corner residence has been thoughtfully upgraded, offering sophisticated finishes such as sleek marble countertops, durable bamboo flooring, and stainless steel appliances. With an open floor plan that seamlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas, this condo is perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. The spacious bathroom has been stylishly updated with Waterworks tile and a spa-like rain shower. Plus, the convenient location places you just minutes from dining, shopping, and public transportation, providing the best of SF at your doorstep. Building amenities include gym, heated pool, spa/sauna, and garage parking. You don't want to miss this opportunity!
